intro: A closer look at how Islamic studies and core academics are sequenced across ICCRA's grade bands — from foundational Qur'an and literacy work in the elementary years to a dedicated higher-level Islamic studies track in grade 7 and above.

gradeBands.title: Foundations
gradeBands.islamic: Arabic literacy, Qur'an memorization with tajweed basics, daily Sunnah practices, and an introduction to Seerah — building the habits students carry through the rest of their time at ICCRA.
gradeBands.academic: Core Math, Science, and ELA through the accredited online partner, with live proctor-supervised sessions and one-on-one tutoring for students who need extra support.

gradeBands.title: Higher-Level Islamic Studies Track
gradeBands.islamic: Students move into ICCRA's dedicated higher-level Islamic studies curriculum, studying Aqeedah, Fiqh, and Tarbiyah in greater depth alongside continued Qur'an and Arabic instruction.
gradeBands.academic: Expanded academic coursework with increasing independence, still supported by live instruction and subject-specific tutoring.

gradeBands.title: Preparation & Leadership
gradeBands.islamic: Continued study of Aqeedah, Fiqh, and Tarbiyah, with opportunities for older students to mentor younger classmates and take on leadership roles within the Islamic studies program.
gradeBands.academic: College- and career-preparatory coursework through the accredited academic partner, with academic advising as students plan their next steps.

advancedTrack.title: Advanced Islamic Studies — Grades 7 and Above
advancedTrack.description: Beginning in 7th grade, ICCRA students enter a higher-level Islamic studies curriculum developed specifically for older students — moving beyond foundational practice into deeper study of creed, jurisprudence, and spiritual development.

subjects.name: Aqeedah
subjects.description: A structured study of Islamic creed — the core beliefs that ground a Muslim's understanding of God, revelation, and the unseen.

subjects.name: Fiqh
subjects.description: Applied Islamic jurisprudence, covering worship, daily conduct, and how Islamic rulings are derived and applied to real life.

subjects.name: Tarbiyah
subjects.description: Ongoing spiritual development and character formation, guided by mentorship from Islamic studies faculty.
